question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs would make the given equation correct?

173 ÷ 169 + 13 × 5 - 13 = 225
solution: Here, we use the BODMAS table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] Given: ⇒ 173 ÷ 169 + 13 × 5 - 13 = 225 (1) + and - ⇒ 173 ÷ 169 + 13 × 5 - 13 = 225 After interchanging the signs: ⇒ __**173 ÷ 169**__ - 13 × 5 + 13 = 225 Apply BODMAS rule: ⇒ 1.02 - __**13 × 5**__ + 13 ⇒ 1.02 - 65 + 13 ⇒ 14.02 - 65 = (-50.97) Here, the equation is not satisfied.
